mdTargetNotionOnboarding.message: Create an internal connection in Notion's developer settings (app.notion.com/developers/connections → New connection), copy its internal token, then open the target page's ··· menu, choose Add connections, and add the connection. Paste the page URL here. Each send creates a new sub-page under it.

mdTargetNotebookLmOnboarding.message: No setup needed. Sending copies the full text to your clipboard and opens NotebookLM. There, add a source, choose Copied text, and paste. NotebookLM has no public API, so the last step stays manual.

mdSendApiPerm.message: Access permission was denied. Full text copied to clipboard; paste to finish.

mdTargetWebhookOnboarding.message: POSTs a JSON payload {title, url, date, tags, markdown} to your endpoint. Any Authorization value you set is sent verbatim (e.g. Bearer <token> or Token <key>), so any auth scheme works. For n8n, Make, Zapier, Readwise, or any self-hosted receiver; no account is needed here.

mdTargetWebhookHttpWarn.message: Blocked: use HTTPS, or HTTP only for localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]. LAN/public HTTP, malformed URLs, and URLs containing credentials are not sent.

mdTargetNotionParentWarn.message: No page ID found in this field. Paste the page's full URL from your browser's address bar.

hlDeleteConfirm.message: Delete this highlight and its note?

hlDegraded.message: Position lost: the surrounding text changed, so this highlight now covers the whole paragraph.

hlOrphanNote.message: $COUNT$ highlights could not be located in the current page content; their notes are kept.

hlOrphanUnlocatable.message: This highlight can't be located in the current page content.

mdImgFixBtn.message: Try to fix this page's images

kbdHelpIntro.message: These shortcuts work on the reader page (not here in Settings).

kbdHelpTranslate.message: Start or continue translating the article

kbdHelpToggleView.message: Cycle through original, bilingual, and translated views

kbdHelpHighlight.message: Highlight the current selection (h = last color used, 1-5 = pick a color)

kbdHelpHighlightNote.message: Highlight the current selection and open its note card

hlFilterEmpty.message: No highlights match the selected colors

skimEnable.message: Generate an AI key-points summary in the reader

skimEnableHint.message: Shows 3-5 key points at the top of the reader. Each generation uses AI tokens; results are cached per article.

skimStaleNote.message: Content has changed; these key points may be out of date

libraryDetailEmpty.message: Pick a word from the list to see its details.

libraryNotesDetailEmpty.message: Pick a highlight from the list to read it in full.

libraryNotesScopeHint.message: Highlights and notes are stored on this device only and are not synced. To move them to another device, export a backup on the settings page and import it there.

mdVideoNoTracks.message: No subtitles are available for this video

mdVideoBiliLogin.message: No subtitles found. Bilibili only returns subtitles when you are logged in — sign in at bilibili.com, then try again.

mdVideoFailed.message: Subtitles are not available for this video through the extension. YouTube restricts subtitle access for some videos.

mdVideoBlocked.message: YouTube blocked this request (it asks to confirm you are not a bot). This is not about the video's subtitles. Try the "Open on YouTube" link, or turn on login cookies in Settings.

mdVideoOpenTabHint.message: Tip: open this video in a YouTube tab, keep it open, and retry — subtitles are then read through that tab.

mdVideoBodyBlocked.message: Subtitle tracks were found, but YouTube withheld their text. Keep this video's YouTube tab open and retry, or pick another track.

mdVideoPermMissing.message: Permission was declined; nothing was loaded

mdVideoAiPunctFail.message: AI punctuation failed; keeping the local result

mdVideoAiPunctPartial.message: $FAIL$ of $TOTAL$ batches failed the check; original text kept. Click again to retry only the failed ones.

mdVideoAiCancelled.message: Cancelled at $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ batches. Progress is cached; click to continue.

mdVideoGrantScope.message: The player needs no permission; the grant is used only to read subtitles

mdVideoFollowReadingOff.message: Follow playback needs the timeline view

mdVideoAwaitingTranscript.message: Fetching subtitles; the transcript will appear here shortly…

mdVideoSeeking.message: Jumping to $TIME$; the player will reload

mdVideoViaDom.message: Captions via the page's transcript panel (lower quality; check for missing lines)

mdVideoPromoted.message: Transcript ready; it has replaced the article

mdVideoAiPunctConfirm.message: AI punctuation replaces the article: existing translations are cleared and Ask citations go stale. Continue?

askScopeNearHint.message: Send only the two paragraphs around the current caption — fewer tokens

hlTimelineHint.message: Switch to the reading view to highlight

mdVideoEstimate.message: Estimated position (Bilibili reports no playback position: the clock starts from the row you click and stops as soon as you use the player; click a row to realign)

mdVideoEstimateIdle.message: Estimate on: click a row to start it

mdVideoEstimateStopped.message: Estimate stopped because you used the player; click a row to realign

mdVideoBiliFailed.message: Could not load this video's details: bilibili's API did not answer, or the video is unavailable.

mdVideoBiliBodyFailed.message: A subtitle track was found, but its text failed to download. Retry, or pick another track.

mdVideoRelaySilent.message: The player is not reporting its position (the YouTube player API did not load): playback follow, the keyboard shortcuts, repeat, auto-pause and playback speed are unavailable for now

mdVideoUnplayable.message: YouTube reports this video as not playable right now ($STATUS$); this is not about subtitles. Open it on YouTube to see why.

mdVideoBridgeEnableHint.message: Let the extension read the playback position from player.bilibili.com (inside this preview only; position and play state, nothing else) so the transcript can follow playback, repeat a cue and pause after each cue, as it does on YouTube.

mdVideoGrantScopeBili.message: The grant covers bilibili's subtitle API and its player page (subtitles and the playback position)

mdVideoBridgeSilent.message: The player is not reporting its position: use the estimated position instead, or reopen the preview to try again

kbdHelpVideoNote.message: Space, Left, Right, r and f need the player to report its position: always on YouTube, on bilibili once playback follow is enabled.

optVideoLangPrefHint.message: Language codes in order of preference, comma separated, e.g. en, zh (English first, then Chinese); a full tag such as zh-Hant is accepted too. The list order always wins; within one language a full tag is matched exactly before falling back to its base code. Leave empty to follow the interface language.

optVideoPauseOnLookup.message: Pause the player while looking a word up

optVideoPauseOnLookupHint.message: Selecting text or opening the explain popover pauses the player (YouTube; bilibili once playback follow is enabled); it resumes when the lookup ends.

optVideoDarkScheme.message: Open video pages in dark mode

optVideoDarkSchemeHint.message: With Theme set to Auto or Light, video pages still open in the dark reading palette. The reader's "Aa" panel can override this for every reader page on this device.

skimWaitingCaptions.message: Key points will be generated once the captions have loaded; use Regenerate to create them now

batchCancelFailed.message: Could not request cancellation. Try again.

connectionOverviewHint.message: Status is based on configuration, granted permissions, and your latest manual tests. Opening Settings never contacts these services or requests permission.

settingsSearchNoResults.message: No matching settings. Try a feature or control name.

diagnosticsHint.message: Copies extension, browser, feature, permission, storage, and categorical error information. Credentials, account names, page URLs, content, and custom endpoints are excluded.

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Could not copy diagnostics. Check clipboard access and try again.

libraryVocabSignedOutHint.message: Vocabulary is kept separate for each Pinboard account. Dictionary lookup remains available without signing in.

libraryLookupSignedOutHint.message: Look up a word above. Sign in to save it to your vocabulary.
